classification.urgency_reason: Payday is tomorrow and payments for 38 employees were rejected with E-102.
classification.summary: Weekly payroll run failed with E-102 for 38 employees; payday is tomorrow and they need to know how to pay everyone on time.
questions: How to make sure the 38 employees are paid on Friday
Whether the same-day option can still be used tomorrow morning
kb_queries: E-102 bank details rejected resubmit payments
support resubmit corrected run on behalf enterprise

draft.body:
Hi Sarah,

Thanks for flagging this quickly. Error E-102 means the bank rejected the details for the employees listed in the run report, usually because of a sort code or account number typo. No money has left your account yet.

To get everyone paid on Friday:
1. Correct the bank details for the 38 employees under People → Pay details.
2. Choose "Resubmit payments" on the run.

As an Enterprise client you can use same-day Faster Payments for runs submitted by 11:00 on payday, so resubmitting by 11:00 tomorrow still gets everyone paid on Friday. If you'd prefer, we can resubmit the corrected run for you once you confirm the corrected details in writing.

citations.supports: What E-102 means and how to fix and resubmit
Same-day Faster Payments until 11:00 on payday for Enterprise
Support can resubmit a corrected run after written confirmation
Acme is on Enterprise and pays weekly on Fridays

classification.urgency_reason: Repeated integration failure before Friday's month-end close, and the client mentions leaving at renewal.
classification.summary: Third QuickBooks sync failure this month; team re-keying journals before Friday's close; considering other providers at the October renewal.
questions: Why did the sync fail again?
Will it happen again?
kb_queries: QuickBooks sync failure authorization expired reconnect

draft.body:
Hi Daniel,

I'm sorry. Having your team re-key journals by hand at month end is not acceptable, and I understand why your confidence has been shaken.

Here is what we know. The failures on 16-17 September were caused by a change to the QuickBooks API; it was fixed on 17 September and the affected journals were re-sent automatically. Separately, QuickBooks connections expire after 100 days, or sooner if the QuickBooks admin's password changes, and the nightly sync then fails with "Authorization expired". If that is behind this latest failure, reconnecting under Settings → Integrations → QuickBooks and pressing "Sync now" sends all the missed journals, so nothing is lost.

Priya, your account manager, will call you today to confirm the cause of this failure and what we're doing to stop it happening again before your close on Friday.

citations.supports: 16-17 September QuickBooks API change, fixed on 17 September, journals re-sent
Connections expire after 100 days; reconnect and Sync now resends missed journals
Kestrel is at risk with renewal on 31 October; Priya owns the account

missing_info: Check the sync log for the error behind this latest failure

draft.body:
Hi Nils,

Congratulations on the new hires. Going from 7 to 10 people keeps you on the Starter plan, which covers up to 10 employees, so your plan won't change.

Starter is £6 per employee per month (minimum £30), so with 10 employees your price will be £60 a month once the three new starters are added. If you grow beyond 10, you'll be prompted to upgrade to Growth, and all your data and settings carry over.
